title: Passive recon of owned target
plain_language: This means running only passive OSINT checks against a target the user owns or controls, then recording what worked without collecting credentials or touching third-party systems.
why_it_matters: This keeps the task inside the approved authorization and dual-use tier while producing evidence that the lab workflow works.
user_inputs_needed: Target placeholder or owned scope reference, such as SELF_PROFILE_URL
Allowed tool categories, such as search-engine review or metadata inspection
Evidence type to capture, such as screenshots, logs, or sanitized CLI output
do_not_send: personal profile URLs unless explicitly needed and safe to store locally
gate: authorize | baseline | build | deploy | execute | validate | redact | publish-approval | decommission
